About the Job

At Certivity, we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Data team. You will design and build the services that extract structured data from regulatory documents, and the tooling that verifies this data is correct once it's in our systems. This is a chance to work on complex engineering challenges with massive real-world impact. You will work alongside a sharp, collaborative team and ship production systems end-to-end.
